info.title: paradise
info.description: The Paradise engine CLI: create a project, verify and build its assets, and report on the build toolchain.

commands.name: build
commands.description: compile assets/ into build/ (or .editor/play with --editor)

options.name: --project
options.description: the project root (default: found from the working directory)

options.name: --profile
options.description:
a build profile declared in project.toml
(omitted: the built-in defaults — toml, full quality)

commands.name: catalogue
commands.description: regenerate the Asset Browser catalogue of prefabs (needs Blender)

commands.name: clean
commands.description: delete derived output (build/, and .editor/ unless kept)

commands.name: mv
commands.description: move a file or directory under assets/ with its sidecars,

commands.name: prefab-check
commands.description: police (or restore) canonical form of *.prefab documents

commands.name: verify
commands.description: check the assets/ tree: sidecars, identities, validity

commands.name: watch
commands.description: keep *.meta in step, rebuilding .editor/play (play mode on)
